_note: D22 (Beau, 2026-10-17). Operating points for the probe's S0 generator, chosen from the self-consistent screen (resemblance_screen.py; every cell at its own measured time scales) after the 50-seed recheck (resemblance_stage2.py) by the pre-stated rule: smallest four-summary loss among cells matched on the three diversity summaries with an accepted time-scale measurement. The top eight cells are not distinguishable at 50 seeds. Rates are an operating point matched to four summaries; population is not identified separately from innovation and mixing; the only demographic anchor in the record is Morse and Morse 1996, p. 17. The secondary point is a declared second S0 generator (different kernel and population). No cell reaches the observed two-cluster F_ST (0.0062) at its median; the best plateau at about two thirds of it with the observed value near the 70th percentile of the seed-to-seed spread; the consequence is measured in the model's own terms at pilot step 7.
